clarification_questions.question: Do you already have numerical acceptance criteria, such as required accuracy or a detection limit?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Yes, they are defined: plan: test against the agreed criteria; Not yet: plan: agree numerical criteria before the test)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: Without them the experiment has no go or no-go criterion.

clarification_questions.question: Over what concentration ranges must protein and fat be monitored in each stream, where relevant?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Narrow, around a set point: plan: sample around the set point; Wide, from low to high: plan: sample the full range)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The range decides whether the sensitivity of a method can be enough.

clarification_questions.question: How quickly must a result be available for each stream?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Real time, within seconds: plan: a short link and fast sampling; Hours are fine: plan: at-line sampling may be enough)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The response time limits the measurement and sampling set-up.

clarification_questions.question: Where could a probe be installed for each stream?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: Access and cleaning decide the probe geometry and the maintenance effort.

clarification_questions.question: Would either measurement point be hot, under pressure or prone to build-up?
clarification_questions.decision_it_changes: The acceptance criteria and the feasibility plan (Yes, hot, pressurised or fouling: adds risk: a hot or fouling interface)
clarification_questions.why_it_matters: The conditions decide the interface and the probe ratings to confirm.

rationale.text: In-line NIR reflection is used for opaque or highly concentrated dairy products, including whole milk concentrates.

conditions.text: Retain diffuse reflection as an option for the whey only if sample tests demonstrate a usable diffuse-reflection signal.

limitations.text: Transmission fails when milk becomes too thick or fat-rich for light to penetrate.

feasibility_plan.objective: Assess whether the proposed NIR interfaces can support composition monitoring in each stream against laboratory results for the relevant targets.
clarify_first: Does the client already have numerical acceptance criteria, such as an accuracy or a detection limit?
In which range must the target variable be followed?

samples_and_states.text: Collect samples from each stream across client-confirmed composition ranges and relevant physical states.

reference_measurements.text: Pair spectra with laboratory protein and fat results wherever each variable is relevant, matching sampling times.

setup.text: Acquire spectra under matched sample conditions, screening conditional interfaces for usable signals before including them in calibration.

comparison.text: Compare interface-specific chemometric predictions with matched laboratory results across the sampled physical states.

validation.text: Validate each stream’s models on independent material excluded from calibration and model selection.

go_no_go.text: Make a separate go/no-go decision for each stream and relevant target using acceptance criteria agreed with you before testing.

not_demonstrated.text: Achievable prediction errors, response times and performance beyond the tested conditions remain unknown.

steps: Clarify ranges, acceptance criteria, timing and installation constraints.
Collect representative samples and reserve independent validation material.
Obtain time-matched laboratory results for relevant targets.
Set up interfaces and compare spectra and calibrated predictions.
Validate on independent material against agreed criteria.
Decide go or no-go separately for each stream and target.

decision_basis.text: Base interface selection on comparison with laboratory results on independent material against client-agreed acceptance criteria.
